notes.title: June 3rd, 2025 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, this is Nocturn.
First of all, I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has played and shown interest in <Eternal Glory>.

Thanks to your feedback, I have made the following updates. I would appreciate it if you could download the latest version.

[u][b]-Added option to turn screen shake effects On/Off.
-Significantly improved Japanese translation.
[/b][/u]

Thank you.

notes.title: Demo has been Updated!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This is Nocturn.
I'm here to announce that the demo of [Eternal Glory] has been generally updated.


[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[u]▶A large update to backgrounds and BGMs.[/u]
▶Improved system convenience features.
▶You can now play up to Chapter 2 of Haize's route.


I've changed most of the arts(including OSTs), so if you're interested in new version, feel free to download it!
